title: Keybindings
scope: Shortcuts work only while this app window is focused, not while you use another app. Changes are saved on this device automatically.
instructions: Select Record, then press a key with Ctrl (⌘ on Mac) or Alt. Escape cancels; Tab cancels and moves focus. Use Remove to unbind an action.
physicalKeys: Bindings use physical key positions; key names follow the US keyboard layout. Some browser or operating-system shortcuts cannot be assigned.
duplicate: This shortcut is assigned to {{action}}. Remove or change that binding first, then try again.
reserved: This combination is reserved by the app, browser or operating system. Choose another shortcut.
unsupported: Choose a key with Ctrl (⌘ on Mac) or Alt. Modifier-only keys, text input and unsupported keys cannot be assigned.
cancelled: Recording cancelled. Your shortcut is unchanged.
